title: First Impressions
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has dominado las presentaciones ejecutivas básicas. El nivel A1 te espera.

parts.visual: En el entorno corporativo de Estados Unidos, un 'First Impression' sólido define la relación comercial.
parts.audio: In the US corporate environment, a solid first impression defines the business relationship.

parts.visual: Aprende a usar 'hello' y presentarte formalmente.
parts.audio: Learn how to use 'hello' and introduce yourself formally.

questions.question: ____, my name is John. I am the new project manager.
questions.explanation: 'Hello' es el saludo formal y universal en negocios.

questions.question: Nice to meet you. ____ are you from?
questions.explanation: 'Where' se usa para preguntar el origen o ubicación.

questions.question: We ____ a meeting at 10 AM.
questions.explanation: Con el pronombre 'We', se usa la forma base 'have'.

questions.question: ____ is the CEO of the company?
questions.explanation: 'Who' se refiere a personas (¿Quién?).

questions.question: Our headquarters ____ located in New York.
questions.explanation: 'Headquarters' como sede corporativa única toma verbo singular 'is'.

questions.question: Please send the report ____ Friday.
questions.explanation: Se usa 'by' para establecer límites de tiempo (a más tardar el viernes).

questions.question: I look forward to ____ with you.
questions.explanation: Después de 'look forward to' el verbo lleva '-ing'.

questions.question: Can I have your ____ card?
questions.explanation: 'Business card' es la tarjeta de presentación.

questions.question: He is the new ____ of sales.
questions.explanation: 'Director' es el sustantivo correcto para el puesto.

questions.question: ____ you have any questions?
questions.explanation: 'Do' es el auxiliar para preguntas en presente simple con 'you'.

questions.question: Welcome ____ OnixLingo Enterprises.
questions.explanation: 'Welcome to' es la estructura correcta para dar bienvenida a un lugar.

questions.question: She ____ Spanish and English fluently.
questions.explanation: Con 'She' en presente simple, el verbo lleva 's'.

questions.question: Let me ____ my colleague, Sarah.
questions.explanation: Después de 'Let me', el verbo va en su forma base.

questions.question: What does your company ____?
questions.explanation: Con el auxiliar 'does', el verbo principal vuelve a su forma base 'do'.

questions.question: The meeting is ____ the third floor.
questions.explanation: Usamos 'on' para pisos de edificios.

questions.question: We offer excellent customer ____.
questions.explanation: 'Customer service' (servicio al cliente) es un término corporativo estándar.

questions.question: ____ is the agenda for today's meeting.
questions.explanation: 'Here is' se usa para presentar o entregar un documento.

questions.question: I ____ from the London office.
questions.explanation: 'I am' es la conjugación del verbo 'To Be'.

questions.question: Could you ____ spell your last name?
questions.explanation: 'Please' es el marcador formal de cortesía.

questions.question: Thank you for ____ time.
questions.explanation: 'Your' es el posesivo para 'tu tiempo'.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra exacta para completar la frase.

questions.question: ____, my name is Alex from Marketing.
questions.explanation: El saludo inicial básico en inglés corporativo.

questions.question: Nice to ____ you.
questions.explanation: 'Nice to meet you' significa 'un placer conocerte'.

questions.question: I am the new project ____.
questions.explanation: 'Manager' significa gerente.

questions.question: Welcome ____ our corporate office.
questions.explanation: Se usa 'to' después de 'Welcome'.

questions.question: Please take a ____.
questions.explanation: 'Take a seat' es la forma profesional de decir 'toma asiento'.

questions.question: Here is my business ____.
questions.explanation: La tarjeta de negocios se llama 'business card'.

questions.question: Could you repeat that, ____?
questions.explanation: Siempre añade 'please' al pedir clarificaciones.

questions.question: What is your phone ____?
questions.explanation: Solicitar el número de contacto es crucial en negocios.

questions.question: We ____ a great team here.
questions.explanation: 'Tenemos' se traduce como 'have'.

questions.question: Thank you very ____.
questions.explanation: La expresión completa es 'Thank you very much'.

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.explanation: El audio dice 'Hello, my name is Sarah'.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.explanation: El saludo es 'Nice to meet you'.

questions.question: Listen carefully.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.explanation: Ofrece su tarjeta diciendo 'Here is my business card'.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.explanation: Se presenta como 'I am the new manager'.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.explanation: La invitación a sentarse es 'Please take a seat'.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.explanation: Describe al equipo: 'We have a great team'.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.explanation: Pregunta de origen: 'Where are you from?'.
